summary: BlackRock Private Investments Fund filed an 8-K reporting preliminary results of its issuer tender offer that expired May 29, 2026. It received valid tenders of 214,339 shares (0.65% of outstanding) against a target of up to 5%. The purchase price will be net asset value per share as of June 30, 2026. This is a normal-course issuer self-tender for a closed-end fund. The final results will be disclosed after price calculation and payment. As the take-up is far below the maximum, there is no arbitrage angle; the fund simply repurchases shares at NAV.
